categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research and development, production, and sales of cosmetic plastic packaging containers. Main products include cream bottle series and lotion bottle series, with over 1,000 product specifications. The company also extends into washing care, color cosmetics, and food packaging categories. Products are manufactured using various materials including PMMA (acrylic), PP, ABS, PETG, and AS.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in precision cutting and machining, multi-cavity mold technology, and high-durability mold manufacturing. Key production methods include injection molding, silk-screen printing, hot stamping, and coating processes. The company has implemented intelligent manufacturing with automated assembly lines, smart warehousing and logistics systems, and integrated MES, WCS, and CRM systems for production management and optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic and international cosmetic brands including Estée Lauder, Ourhealthcare, Shanghai Jahwa, Huaxi Biology, Furuida, Wenbi Spring, Carslan, Lin Qingxuan, and Rock Zoo. Primary customers are cosmetic brand enterprises in domestic markets and professional supply chain management companies in international markets. The company serves high-end cosmetic brands requiring premium packaging materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, China, located in the Yangtze River Delta region. It operates primarily in China with significant export business. Major operating regions include Zhejiang and surrounding areas in East China. The company has a subsidiary in Shanghai (Shanghai Jianhong Technology Co., Ltd.) and another in Zhejiang (Zhejiang Jinsheng Lithium Co., Ltd.). Export markets are primarily in North America and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (PMMA, PETG, ABS, AS, PP) from international suppliers and packaging components from local suppliers, then manufactures finished cosmetic packaging containers for direct sale to cosmetic brand enterprises and supply chain management companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous R&D investment to improve product quality and develop new products. Strategic priorities include: enhancing research and development capabilities through collaboration with scientific institutions; developing new product structures and packaging solutions; implementing 3D printing technology for rapid prototyping; extending product lines from skincare to color cosmetics and washing care categories; and pursuing sustainable development through eco-friendly materials like PCR plastics and degradable plastics.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of cosmetic plastic packaging containers to cosmetic brand enterprises and supply chain management companies. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, which occurs upon customer signature confirmation for domestic sales and upon export customs clearance for export sales. The company also generates minor revenue from mold sales and other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The cosmetic plastic packaging industry has numerous participants, primarily small and medium-sized enterprises. The company positions itself as a mid-to-large scale manufacturer with strong technical capabilities and quality management. Major competitive advantages include established relationships with leading international brands, comprehensive product portfolio, advanced manufacturing technology, and superior supply chain position. The company faces competition from both domestic and international competitors but maintains competitive advantages through scale, quality, and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of approximately 259.86 million yuan, representing 7.04% growth from 2022 (242.77 million yuan). However, the company reported a net loss of 23.87 million yuan in 2023 compared to a loss of 22.51 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 852.36 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced declining profitability in recent years despite revenue growth, primarily due to weak international demand and underutilized production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product design and customization capabilities, offering over 1,000 product specifications tailored to customer needs. Key value propositions include: crystal-clear transparency and excellent optical properties of acrylic materials; high surface gloss and hardness; excellent printability and coating properties; comprehensive one-stop service from design to production; rapid market response capability; and commitment to sustainable, eco-friendly packaging solutions. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and long-term partnerships with premium brand customers.
